nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

Pick a **Mode**; only the images that mode uses are read:

| Mode | Uses |
|---|---|
| T2V | prompt |
| I2V (first frame) | First frame |
| Last frame | Last frame |
| First + last frame | both |
| R2V (references) | Reference 1 + 2 (write <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> in the prompt) |
| Multiframe | reference images + 3 guide frames at the times you set |
| ControlNet (pose) | Video (pose is read from it) |
| Extend (continue a clip) | Video: its last 22 frames (~0.9 s) start the new clip and H3 continues it. The result begins with those frames, so trim ~0.9 s when you join the clips. Load a result back in to keep extending. |

**Character swap** (the 9th H3 mode) needs the Viggle model + its node pack, so I kept it in its own workflow to keep this one core-nodes only: [Viggle-Animate (H3)](https://github.com/Thefrizzy1/The_frizzy1-Workflows/tree/main/workflows/minimax/viggle-animate-h3).

**Turbo** = 8 steps (FL2VA) / 4 steps (Ref2VA) with the turbo LoRAs; off = 20 steps.
Size: 0.4 MP = 864x480 (2-5 min on the 3060), 0.9 MP = 1280x736 (6-13 min). Stay at 0.9 MP or below on 12 GB: 1.5 MP spills out of VRAM and took over 30 min. Needs about 17-22 GB of system RAM (32 GB recommended).

Only downloaded the T2V/I2V files (~42 GB)? ComfyUI still checks every loader: point the red Ref2VA, LoRA, ControlNet, SDPose and RT-DETR loaders at any file you have. They never load in the FL2VA modes.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 GB (tested) | `diffusion_models/` | [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 21.0 GB |
| 12 GB (tested) | `diffusion_models/` | [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 21.0 GB |
| all | `loras/` | [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) | 2.0 GB |
| all | `loras/` | [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) | 2.0 GB |
| all | `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | 15.7 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 2.8 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | 0.6 GB |
| ControlNet mode | `model_patches/` | [minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/model_patches/minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 2.3 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/SDPose](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| ControlNet mode | `checkpoints/` | [sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/resolve/main/checkpoints/sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors) | 1.9 GB |
| ControlNet mode | `diffusion_models/` | [rt_detr_v4-x-hgnet_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/resolve/main/diffusion_models/rt_detr_v4-x-hgnet_fp16.safetensors) | 0.1 GB |

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.37.4._
